Question ID: CW_U01_L01_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.02

Which sentence best describes the purpose of workshop norms in Creative Writing?

answer.text: Workshop norms make every writer use the same style.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Norms guide the process, but writers keep their individual styles.

answer.text: Workshop norms replace revision because feedback is enough.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Feedback supports revision; it does not replace revision.

answer.text: Workshop norms are only needed for published authors.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Student writers also need clear routines for sharing and responding.

answer.text: Workshop norms help writers share, listen, respond respectfully, and revise with clear support.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer is supported by MLA.CW.COM.02 because it selects a specific craft move or revision decision: "Workshop norms help writers share, listen, respond respectfully, and revise with clear support.". That choice matches the prompt instead of giving a vague reaction, an unsupported preference, or a detail outside the draft.
